      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_finite_stable_add_generators_of_rank_le_two {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (hr : (simpleIsomorphismClasses R).ncard ≤ 2) (hR : IsEFinite R) :
      ∃ (s : List (TwoTerm R)), (∀ Q ∈ s, Q.IsPresilting) ∧ ∀ (P : TwoTerm R), P.IsPresilting → ∃ Q ∈ s, P.IsInStableAdd Q

      With at most two simple classes, an E-finite algebra has a finite list of presilting complexes whose stable additive closures cover all presilting complexes.
